info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Transaction Update API
info.description: The Transaction Update API enables users to modify existing transactions within their banking accounts. This API supports adjustments to transaction details, allowing financial institutions and users to ensure accuracy in their records. It is specifically designed for banking applications that require transaction management capabilities, catering to developers building financial solutions. Typical consumers include developers of banking apps, accounting software, and online transaction platforms seeking to maintain updated financial data.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific transaction engine resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary information in the request body to apply the changes successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update existing transaction records in the account management system. It follows the structure defined in the schema to ensure proper data handling and processing.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the resource has been updated.
